programme.title: Golmaal: Fun Unlimited
programme.desc: The story revolves around the lives of four guys named Gopal, Lucky, Madhav, and Laxman who all absurdly fall for the same girl. Hence, begins the hilarious race to win her heart.

programme.title: Golmaal Returns
programme.desc: Gopal’s life hits choppy waters when he gets stuck on a yacht for a night upon rescuing an attractive young woman by fighting off some goons. Now, he has his wife suspecting him of having an affair and a police officer on his tail.

programme.title: Rajnigandha
programme.desc: Deepa (Vidya Sinha), a highly qualified girl with simple dreams, is betrothed to Sanjay (Amol Palekar), a forgetful, tardy but lovable and caring boyfriend. Deepa goes to Mumbai for a job interview and chances upon Navin (Dinesh Thakur), her old boyfriend from college who was a passionate youngster and has now become a responsible and successful man. Through the course of the story, Deepa finds herself caught in a dilemma as she reminisces her past with Navin and her future with Sanjay. Will Navin's sudden appearance in her life change her heart?

programme.title: Hum Hain Lajawaab
programme.desc: A rich and rigid city man Pawan must fetch the young son of his deceased brother. As he travels, he meets a host of less blessed people and starts questioning his own ideologies.

programme.title: Luck
programme.desc: Musa, an underworld kingpin and a firm believer in luck, designs a series of life threatening adventure sports with hefty prize money for people around the world. However, the participants can only survive and win if they are exceptionally lucky.

programme.title: Raja Hindustani
programme.desc: A young taxi driver and a rich city girl fall head over heels in love with each other. Defying her family, she marries him and relocates to his village. But her family weaves a web of deception to split them apart.
